'''Umé'''<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], light-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo's]] [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|Naboo Royal Handmaidens]].<ref name="DaG" /> Like all [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]], Umé was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the Human [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] culture<ref name="SoN Handmaidens" /> hailing from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SoN Handmaidens" />  In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]</ref> Umé was part of the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] procession of [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and former [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], walking behind [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]] with fellow handmaiden<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Hollé/Legends|Hollé]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> The ceremony was held in Naboo's<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="CSWE Theed">{{CSWECite|III|325|Theed}}</ref> [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. At the funeral, the handmaiden wore a hooded red [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] patterned with<ref name="ROTS" /> the [[Naboo royal crest/Legends|Naboo royal crest]].<ref name="Fact File 34">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 34|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 34]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Umé first appeared, portrayed by an uncredited extra, in the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[2005]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" /> The funeral scene that featured the character was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Umé was later identified by name in the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" department in the [[Star Wars Insider 142|142nd]] edition of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', written by [[Leland Chee]]<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> and released on [[June 11]], [[2013]].<ref name="SWI 142 release date">[[Star Wars Insider 141|''Star Wars Insider'' 141]]</ref>
